content.p1: Create a web application to view all the short videos about Marvel movies. So far, we've created four pages that are organized in a way that is easy to recognize at a glance. On the homepage and each page, we implemented the Marvel logo and menu, and used Marvel-related space photos as backgrounds.
content.p2: Create a snowflake growing game using JAVA. As with any game program, press start with the name Snowflake Maker on the start screen to start the game. In the upper left corner, you can see the level of the character and press the QUIT button in the upper right corner to end the game. At the bottom, there are buttons for studying and checking your answers.

content.p4:
I'm a person who chooses challenges over hesitation. The courage to take the first step in front of a new environment or an unfamiliar field has always been an important value in my life, and I have gained a variety of experiences by not hesitating to face change and find answers. 

 The first challenge was in the IT field. I was curious about how computer languages are organized rather than human languages, so I pursued a major in IT, and even though it was a new field, I learned the basics through continuous learning and practice. 

 The second challenge was my academic experience abroad through an exchange student program. In college, I applied to an exchange program in Utah, USA, where I quickly adapted to an unfamiliar language and culture and succeeded in my studies and projects. Although I had taken classes with native speakers in Korea, it was a new challenge for me to take classes and hold discussions with actual American students. By not hesitating to participate in class and discussions, and by actively communicating with professors and students, I was able to successfully complete the exchange program. 

 The third challenge is strengthening practical skills. To compensate for my relative lack of practical experience as a double major student, I took a capstone design class and tried to gain project-based experience rather than exam-based classes. In the HTML class, I created a personal website based on my hobbies, and in the capstone class, I developed a programming quiz game that could be interesting to non-technical people. For my graduation project, I expanded my practical project experience by working with a team to create an OTT content curation website based on a recommendation system. 

 With an attitude of “not being afraid of new challenges” and “quick adaptability,” I am a person who can diligently accomplish given goals in any environment. I hope to continue to grow and expand my own limits through challenges.
